verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a self-hosted or on-premises deployment of Missive; it is presented only as a hosted service. Connecting your own IMAP/SMTP servers (including ones with self-signed certificates) is an adjacent account-connection feature, not self-hosting the app. A community report also notes that mail is fetched through Missive's own servers, so the pipeline is not under the user's control.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can self-host the email app and keep the mail pipeline under my own control
